title: A Dataset You Can Trust: Demonstrations as Samples, a Scale Taken from the Training Part, and a Split by Episode

artifact.note: the data a learned policy is made from: a car keeping to a lane (its offset from the centre line and its heading error, steered by a turn rate) and an expert that steers it with a proportional law limited to the largest turn; demonstrations as samples of the state the expert saw and the action it chose, each tagged with its episode, with the expert's execution made a little noisy; a scale (mean and spread of each input) taken from the training part only; two ways to split a dataset into a training and a test part, by sample and by episode; and a nearest-neighbour predictor that shows how a split by sample makes the test look better than it is
